items.text: Huge opportunity right now to build new services firms from the ground up, or transform existing ones, with agents at the center. The expertise that services firms in theory should have is as important as ever because you still need deep domain understanding to get the most out of agents. But now the ability to deliver on projects has a 10X multiplier. This means that you can make clients happier, compete to win more of them, go after smaller customers not in the TAM before, or deliver outcomes that weren’t really conceivable. items.text: 12 tips for people who posted on LinkedIn but now wanna post on X A lot of people I know are moving their posting from LinkedIn to X. When they ask me how I grew 80k followers on X in one year, here’s what I tell them: 1. LinkedIn is a stage. X is a party. First you find your crowd, then you listen to what they're already talking about. Don't start talking until you get it 2. You can't reach the C-suite directly. LinkedIn is a professional network, so you can go straight to decision makers. X doesn't work like that. You have to get mass attention first, and then the right people notice you 3. items.title: I'm thankful for all the optimists
items.text: I'm thankful for all the optimists. Americans are a profoundly optimistic bunch, and I think it's one of the things you really appreciate and are drawn to as an immigrant. In order to define the future and lead the world, you must possess a positive vision of what's to come. These days many people speak in terms of a future we must blindly accept and capitulate to. Instead, we must use our, yes, agency to build and project the amazing future we want for our grandchildren and loved ones. Happy thanksgiving!
